title: Adobe
subtitle: The NetsuRush panel reads the project open in Premiere Pro or After Effects (2020 and later) and sends it here.

panel.restartHint: (restart the app if it was already open).
panel.installHint: Click "Install panel", then open Premiere Pro/After Effects ▸ Window ▸ Extensions ▸ NetsuRush.
panel.autoUpdateHint: The panel installs as soon as an Adobe app is detected, then updates with NetsuRush.
panel.updatePending: A newer panel ships with this version of NetsuRush
panel.restartApps: Panel updated — restart {{apps}} to reload it.

diag.verdictOk: Installed ✓ (folder + manifest + PlayerDebugMode). Open the panel in Adobe: Window ▸ Extensions ▸ NetsuRush.
diag.cepLogNone: CEP log: no NetsuRush ERROR (normal — the log only mentions the extension when it fails to load).

status.openPanelHint: Open the panel: Window ▸ Extensions ▸ NetsuRush.
status.launchThenOpenHint: Launch the app, then open Window ▸ Extensions ▸ NetsuRush.

snapshot.noProject: No project received — open the NetsuRush panel in the app, then "Send to NetsuRush".
snapshot.noFileMedia: No file-based media in the project.

notice.installedRestart: Panel installed. RESTART {{apps}}, then Window ▸ Extensions ▸ NetsuRush.
notice.installedOpen: Panel installed. Open Premiere Pro/After Effects, then Window ▸ Extensions ▸ NetsuRush.
notice.autoUpdateFailed: Could not change the update setting
